findings: Five Short Pieces for alto saxophone and piano, Molenaar06.0889.70, copyright2006. Publisher catalog gives five minutes; actual recorded duration is about7:40.
Movements verified by recording label: Introduction,Cristallica,Remain a Dreamer,Themism,Be a Realist.
Composer performs with pianist Henry Kelder on ZBOP!, recorded13–14July2018 in Amsterdam and released by MatchingArts. Label calls these first recordings.

score_observations: Publisher catalog printed p28 shows first two alto movements and opening full score. Introduction is Moderato quarter74 with sustained trill, chromatic rising thirty-second-note flourish, large dynamic contrasts, and changing common/3/4/5/4 meters.

Cristallica begins Largo misterioso quarter52, long soft sustained notes and chromatic line; Allegro quarter120 develops accented sixteenth-note figures. Several high ledger-line notes and fingering annotations are visible; no legend available to interpret the annotations.
